name: finance-incident-multi-agent
description: FastAPI service orchestrating specialized AI agents with LangGraph to analyze financial incidents, assess risk, detect fraud, evaluate compliance, and produce a monitored decision.

agents.name: SupervisorAgent
agents.role: Runs the compiled LangGraph workflow and formats the final API response.

agents.name: RiskAgent
agents.role: Analyzes financial risk level and score.

agents.name: FraudAgent
agents.role: Detects fraud suspicion and fraud signals.

agents.name: ComplianceAgent
agents.role: Evaluates AML, KYC, governance, and escalation requirements.

agents.name: MonitoringAgent
agents.role: Tracks execution status, correlation id, latency, and observability flags.

limitations: The project is designed for training and demonstration purposes.
The default monitoring checks are deterministic and keyword or regex based.
AI results depend on the configured Grok service and should be reviewed before production use.
No external API call should be performed in unit tests.
safety_rules: Return structured JSON for AI agent outputs.
Use controlled fallbacks when Grok or parsing fails.
Block or review incidents with high risk, fraud suspicion, compliance escalation, prompt injection, or PII findings.
Always return a correlation_id for traceability.
Never expose secrets or API keys in logs or responses.
